content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"eq","value":11},{"path":"body.y","op":"eq","value":1}]},"modes":[{"id":"fight-adjacent","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"lte","value":1}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"swing"}},{"id":"navigate-to-ladder","priority":5,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"gte","value":0}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"climb-mine"}}],"skills":[{"name":"swing","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); const m = ms.find(m => Math.abs(m.x-p.x)+Math.abs(m.y-p.y)===1); if (m) { await b.faceAndPress(m.x, m.y, 'ControllerX', 0); } return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => ({ok:true, detail:'swung'})"},{"name":"climb-mine","skill":"async (b) => { const path=[[6,8],[7,8],[8,8],[9,8],[10,8],[11,8],[11,7],[11,6],[11,5],[11,4],[11,3],[11,2],[11,1]]; for (const [x,y] of path) { let p=await b.body(); if (p.x===x && p.y===y) continue; const ms=await b.monsters(); const near=ms.find(m=>Math.abs(m.x-p.x)+Math.abs(m.y-p.y)<=1); if (near) { await b.faceAndPress(near.x,near.y,'ControllerX',0); } const r=await b.walkTo(x,y,'stand'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('walk fail '+x+','+y+' '+r.reason); await b.wait(150); } } return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => { const p=await b.body(); return {ok:p.x===11&&p.y===1, detail:'at '+p.x+','+p.y}; }"}]}
